objective: Review the scoped sidecar-launcher run boundary after the accepted bridge fixture metadata and decide whether a future run gate may attempt launcher invocation and coverage-output compare from the native path.

review_decision.reason: The boundary is narrow enough for a first launcher-invocation attempt because it starts from reviewed bridge fixture metadata, keeps the target to pulp_ita_mha 64x1, uses the existing run_hybrid_template launcher, and keeps coverage_output_equivalence as the only correctness policy.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still review-only. It does not invoke the launcher, execute sidecar stages, record native-path compare, or measure timing. A later run may still stop at sidecar_launcher_bridge_failure, sidecar_stage_failure, or compare_failure.
accepted_because: the source definition is explicitly definition-only
the eligible input is limited to reviewed sidecar-launcher bridge fixture metadata
the launcher entrypoint remains the existing src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py path
the run scope remains pulp_ita_mha, config/slice_launch_templates/pulp_ita_mha.json, and 64x1
coverage_output_equivalence is the accepted compare policy and raw full-state equality remains out of scope
generated reports and artifacts remain noncanonical evidence

required_next_gate.name: run_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_sidecar_launcher_gate
must_record: whether reviewed bridge metadata invokes the existing sidecar launcher from the native path
whether sidecar stages execute after launcher invocation
whether coverage-output compare is reached from the native path
the exact failure class if the chain stops
all generated reports and artifacts as noncanonical evidence

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
